summary: PERSONA-1 Workstreams C+F+3a (admin persona preview) — end-to-end verified. Backend: 28/28 base persona pytests pass; added a new test_iter76_admin_override.py (4 additional cases) that (a) grants admin_role on cathy in-mongo, (b) exercises the admin-only override path, and (c) unsets admin_role in fixture teardown. All 32 backend tests green. Frontend: signup persona toggle (caregiver → participant → caregiver) works and the 3 caregiver fields (signup-cr-first-name / signup-cr-relationship / signup-cr-pronouns) render only for caregiver role. Full caregiver signup (Louisa / daughter / she_her) and participant signup both persist correctly (viewer_persona, care_recipient.is_self, first_name mirror, pronouns, relationship). DEC-1 retrofit hero swaps through 3 states verified live on /app/statements/{id} (Louisa preview → participant preview → cleared/default care_recipient), ADM disclosure renders with the substituted name. Non-admin gating verified: cathy without admin_role does NOT see persona-preview-card on /settings/profile, and any override_persona sent from her session is ignored server-side. localStorage persistence + hydration + clear all work.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup POST → PUT /api/persona is fire-and-forget with a swallowed catch. That's fine for MVP, but consider logging via `track` / Sentry so silent persona-set failures are observable — a caregiver whose PUT quietly failed will look 'clean' in the DB but see the fallback caregiver copy forever until they visit Settings.

DecoderResultView.jsx keeps two persona-hero + adm defaults hardcoded (line 129-134). If the /persona/resolve call fails silently on network error the user sees the generic 'the statement' / no ADM disclosure copy — matches spec, but consider a lightweight retry once (1s backoff) before falling back so a transient blip doesn't degrade Tier-1 copy on first paint.

PersonaPreviewCard writes directly to localStorage and fires a window event. That's fine same-tab, but a multi-tab admin will see the second tab's preview override not update until reload. Optional: subscribe to the `storage` event too if multi-tab is a desired workflow.

usePersona hook's _bundleCache is a module-level singleton that never invalidates on user logout/switch. If admin A switches to non-admin session B without a hard reload, B could briefly see A's cached tokens. Suggest clearing _bundleCache on the logout path.

test_persona_routes.py::TestAdminPreviewOverride only covers the non-admin negative case (positive admin path lives in test_iter76_admin_override.py which needs direct mongo access). Fine for now, but if this suite ever moves off the preview env you'll want a fixture that provisions an admin user via API rather than mongo write.
